headline: Axis Direct picks nine stocks for Diwali Muhurat trading in Samvat 2083

headline: DCB Bank allots 81,100 shares under employee stock option plan

headline: Brokerage issues Buy call on DCB Bank following quarterly performance
hook: Broker maintains a positive stance on DCB Bank
summary: DCB Bank reported a 17 per cent increase in net interest income to ₹699 crore alongside a 10 basis point quarter-on-quarter decline in net interest margin to 3.25 per cent. Other income grew by 34 per cent to ₹249 crore, while pre-provision operating profit rose 26 per cent to ₹383 crore. A brokerage has issued a Buy rating for the stock based on these financial metrics. Retail investors tracking banking sector stock recommendations may find this relevant for portfolio decisions.
why_it_matters: Brokerage endorsement may influence near-term stock price movement.
winners_losers: DCB Bank shareholders gain / cautious investors unaffected

headline: DCB Bank reports 28% rise in Q2 net profit with improved asset quality
hook: Profit up 28% on lower bad loans
